الاعتماد على الله مع الأخذ بالأسباب: Relying on Allah while taking the means
ترك الأسباب والجلوس: Leaving the means and sitting back
قال ﷺ للأعرابي: «اعقلها وتوكل» أي خذ بال: The Prophet ﷺ said to the Bedouin: “Tie it, then rely on Allah,” meaning take the means, then trust.
طالب اجتهد في المذاكرة ثم رسب، فما موقفه: A student studied hard but failed. What is his right attitude?
يصبر ويحاول من جديد ويرضى بقدر الله: He is patient, tries again, and accepts Allah's decree
المؤمن يأخذ بالأسباب ثم يرضى بما قدّره ا: The believer takes the means, then accepts what Allah decreed and tries again.
قال تعالى: ﴿وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَ: Allah says: ﴿And whoever relies upon Allah …﴾
فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ: then He is sufficient for him
فَلَا يَتَعَبُ: then he will not get tired
فَيَكْفِيهِ النَّاسُ: then people will be enough for him
من توكل على الله كفاه، وهو سبحانه حسبه و: Whoever relies on Allah, He is enough for him, and He is his Protector.
أيّ مما يلي صورة من صور شكر نعمة الصحة؟: Which of these is a way of thanking Allah for the blessing of health?
استعمالها في الطاعة ونفع الناس: Using it in obedience and to benefit people
نعمة الصحة تُشكر بحسن استعمالها فيما يرض: The blessing of health is thanked by using it well in what pleases Allah.
رتّب خطوات التوكل الصحيح: Put the steps of proper trust in Allah in order
التوكل يجمع بين العمل والاعتماد على الله: Trust in Allah combines effort, relying on Allah, and accepting His decree.
المخارج والصفات والتفخيم: Points of articulation, characteristics, and heavy letters
ما عدد المخارج العامة للحروف؟: How many general points of articulation do the letters have?
هي: الجوف والحلق واللسان والشفتان والخيش: They are: the oral cavity, the throat, the tongue, the two lips, and the nasal cavity.
كم عدد حروف الحلق؟: How many throat letters are there?
They are: ء هـ ع ح غ خ.
أيّ الحروف التالية يخرج من الشفتين؟: Which of these letters comes out from the lips?
الباء والميم والواو من الشفتين، والفاء م: Ba, Meem and Waw come from the two lips, and Fa comes from the lower lip with the tips of the upper front teeth.
من أين تخرج الغنة؟: Where does the Ghunnah come from?
الغنة صوت يخرج من الخيشوم وهو أعلى الأنف: The Ghunnah is a sound that comes from the nasal cavity, the upper part of the nose.
ء هـ ع ح غ خ: ء هـ ع ح غ خ
ي ر م ل و ن: ي ر م ل و ن
تجمعها عبارة: قُطْبُ جَدٍّ، وهي اضطراب ا: They are gathered in the phrase: Qutbu Jadd. It is a vibration of the sound when the letter is silent.
ما حكم اللام في لفظ الجلالة في «قَالَ ال: What is the rule for the Lam in the name of Allah in «قَالَ اللَّهُ»?
تفخّم لام اسم الله إذا سبقها فتح أو ضم،: The Lam in the name of Allah is pronounced heavy after a Fathah or Dammah, and light after a Kasrah.
ما حكم اللام في لفظ الجلالة في «بِسْمِ ا: What is the rule for the Lam in the name of Allah in «بِسْمِ اللَّهِ»?
Because a Kasrah comes before it, so it is pronounced light.
الراء المكسورة مثل «رِزْقًا» تُنطق …: A Ra with a Kasrah, like in «رِزْقًا», is pronounced …
الراء المكسورة ترقق في الأصل، والمفتوحة: A Ra with a Kasrah is light by default, while a Ra with a Fathah or Dammah is heavy.
كم عدد حروف الاستعلاء وهي حروف التفخيم؟: How many elevation letters (Isti’la’), which are the heavy letters, are there?
They are gathered in: Khuss Daghtin Qiz.
رتّب المخارج العامة من الداخل إلى الخارج: Arrange the general articulation points from the inside to the outside
تبدأ المخارج من الجوف ثم الحلق ثم اللسان: The articulation points start from the oral cavity, then the throat, then the tongue, then the lips, and the nasal cavity is for the Ghunnah.
كم عدد أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين؟: How many rules are there for Noon Sakinah and Tanween?
ما حروف الإظهار؟: What are the letters of Izhar?
ت ث ج د ذ ز: ت ث ج د ذ ز
They are the six throat letters.
ما حروف الإدغام؟: What are the letters of Idgham?
ي ر م ل و ن (يرملون): ي ر م ل و ن (Yarmaloon)
They are gathered in the word: Yarmaloon.
ما حرف الإقلاب؟: What is the letter of Iqlab?
تقلب النون أو التنوين ميمًا مخفاة مع غنة: The Noon or Tanween is turned into a hidden Meem with Ghunnah before the letter Ba.
كم حرفًا من حروف الإخفاء؟: How many letters of Ikhfa’ are there?
هي بقية الحروف: ص ذ ث ك ج ش ق س د ط ز ف: They are the remaining letters: ص ذ ث ك ج ش ق س د ط ز ف ت ض ظ.
ما حكم النون في «مِنْ بَعْدِ»؟: What is the rule for the Noon in «مِنْ بَعْدِ»?
It is a Noon Sakinah followed by a Ba.
ما حكم النون في «مَنْ آمَنَ»؟: What is the rule for the Noon in «مَنْ آمَنَ»?
A Hamzah comes after the Noon, and it is one of the throat letters.
ما حكم النون في «مِن رَّبِّهِمْ»؟: What is the rule for the Noon in «مِن رَّبِّهِمْ»?
Ra and Lam are merged into without Ghunnah.
ما حكم النون في «مَن يَقُولُ»؟: What is the rule for the Noon in «مَن يَقُولُ»?
Ya is one of the letters of Yarmaloon and is merged into with Ghunnah.
رتّب أحكام النون الساكنة والتنوين كما يُ: Arrange the rules of Noon Sakinah and Tanween as they are usually taught
This is the usual order in Tajweed books.
كم عدد أحكام الميم الساكنة؟: How many rules are there for Meem Sakinah?
إخفاء شفوي، وإدغام مثلين صغير، وإظهار شف: Labial Ikhfa’, Idgham of two identical letters (small), and labial Izhar.
ما حرف الإخفاء الشفوي؟: What is the letter of labial Ikhfa’?
Meem Sakinah is hidden before Ba with Ghunnah.
ما حكم الميم في «تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ»: What is the rule for the Meem in «تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍ»?
A Meem Sakinah followed by a Ba.
ما حكم الميم في «لَهُم مَّا»؟: What is the rule for the Meem in «لَهُم مَّا»?
إدغام مثلين صغير: Small Idgham of two identical letters
A Meem Sakinah followed by a Meem with a vowel.
ما حكم الميم في «هُمْ فِيهَا»؟: What is the rule for the Meem in «هُمْ فِيهَا»?
يظهر ما بعد الميم لأنه حرف غير الباء وال: The letter after the Meem is pronounced clearly because it is a letter other than Ba and Meem.
عند أي الحروف يكون الإظهار الشفوي أشد؟: Before which letters is labial Izhar strongest?
يجب الحذر من إخفاء الميم قبلهما، مثل: «ع: Be careful not to hide the Meem before them, as in: «عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا».
كم حركة تُمدّ غنة الميم المشددة؟: How many counts is the Ghunnah of a doubled Meem held?
الغنة في الميم والنون المشددتين مقدارها: The Ghunnah in a doubled Meem and Noon lasts two counts.
ما حكم الميم في «أَمْ لَمْ»؟: What is the rule for the Meem in «أَمْ لَمْ»?
وبعدها ميم في «لَمْ» فتُدغم في الميم بعد: It is followed by a Meem in «لَمْ», so it is merged into the Meem after it.
ما حكم الميم في «إِنَّهُم بِهِمْ»؟: What is the rule for the Meem in «إِنَّهُم بِهِمْ»?
A Meem Sakinah followed by the letter Ba.
رتّب أحكام الميم الساكنة: Arrange the rules of Meem Sakinah
كم حركة يُمدّ المد الطبيعي؟: How many counts is the natural Madd held?
المد الطبيعي لا يتوقف على سبب كهمز أو سك: The natural Madd does not depend on a cause such as a Hamzah or a Sukoon.
ما حروف المد؟: What are the letters of Madd?
الألف والواو والياء الساكنتان بشروط: Alif, Waw and Ya when silent, under conditions
الألف الساكنة بعد فتح، والواو الساكنة بع: A silent Alif after a Fathah, a silent Waw after a Dammah, and a silent Ya after a Kasrah.
إذا جاءت الهمزة بعد حرف المد في كلمة واح: When the Hamzah comes after the Madd letter in the same word
إذا جاءت الهمزة في كلمة تالية: When the Hamzah comes in the following word
إذا جاء بعده سكون أصلي: When a basic Sukoon comes after it
ما حكم المد المتصل؟: What is the ruling on the connected Madd?
The reciters agreed that it must be elongated.
كم حركة يُمدّ المتصل في القراءة المعروفة: How many counts is the connected Madd held in the well-known recitation of Hafs?
المشهور في رواية حفص من طريق الشاطبية: أ: The well-known view in Hafs’s narration through Ash-Shatibiyyah is: four or five.
حرف مد في آخر كلمة وهمزة في أول الكلمة ا: A Madd letter at the end of a word and a Hamzah at the start of the next word
همزة بعد مد في كلمة واحدة: A Hamzah after a Madd in one word
سكون أصلي بعد مد: A basic Sukoon after a Madd
مد يأتي عند الوقف فقط: A Madd that occurs only when stopping
ما حكم المد المنفصل؟: What is the ruling on the separated Madd?
سمّي جائزًا لجواز قصره عند بعض القراء، و: It is called permissible because some reciters allow shortening it, and in Hafs it is held four or five counts.
إذا جاء بعد حرف المد سكون أصلي: When a basic Sukoon comes after the Madd letter
إذا جاءت بعده همزة: When a Hamzah comes after it
إذا جاء في آخر السورة فقط: When it comes at the end of a Surah only
إذا كان حرف المد مفتوحًا: When the Madd letter has a Fathah
Like: «الضَّالِّينَ», and it is held six counts.
كم حركة يُمدّ المد اللازم؟: How many counts is the obligatory Madd held?
The reciters agreed to hold it six counts.
رتّب أنواع المد من الأقصر إلى الأطول مقد: Arrange the types of Madd from the shortest to the longest in length
الطبيعي حركتان، المنفصل والمتصل أربع أو: The natural is two counts, the separated and connected are four or five, and the obligatory is six.
قطع الصوت عن الكلمة زمنًا يتنفس فيه القا: Cutting off the sound on a word for a time in which the reciter breathes
Stopping is done with the intention of resuming the recitation afterwards.
ماذا تعني علامة «م» في المصحف؟: What does the sign «م» in the Mushaf mean?
It is preferable to stop there so that the meaning does not change.
ماذا تعني علامة «لا» في المصحف؟: What does the sign «لا» in the Mushaf mean?
ليس المقصود أنه حرام في كل الأحوال بل ين: It does not mean it is forbidden in every case, but one should not stop there.
Stopping and continuing are both permitted.
الوقف أولى مع جواز الوصل: Stopping is better, while continuing is permitted
It is preferable to stop at this sign.
الوصل أولى مع جواز الوقف: Continuing is better, while stopping is permitted
It is preferable to continue there.
الشروع في القراءة بعد قطع أو وقف: Beginning the recitation after a break or a stop
ينبغي أن يبتدئ القارئ بمكان يصحّ فيه الم: The reciter should start at a place where the meaning is sound.
كيف يوقف على التاء المربوطة مثل «رَحْمَة: How do you stop on a Ta Marbutah like in «رَحْمَةٌ»?
You stop on it as a Ha, so you say: Rahmah.
كيف يوقف على الاسم المنون المنصوب مثل «ع: How do you stop on an accusative word with Tanween like «عَلِيمًا»?
The two Fathahs are replaced by an Alif when stopping.
رتّب خطوات القارئ عند علامة وقف: Arrange the reciter’s steps at a stop sign
يسكّن آخر الكلمة: He makes the end of the word silent
يبدأ بما يصحّ معناه: He starts with what makes sense
الوقف يكون على السكون وبعد التنفس ثم الا: Stopping is done on a Sukoon and after breathing, then starting where the meaning is sound.
ما موضوع حديث «إنما الأعمال بالنيات»؟: What is the topic of the Hadith «Actions are only by intentions»?
أهمية النية في صحة العمل وقبوله: The importance of intention for an action to be sound and accepted
It is the first Hadith in the Forty Hadith of an-Nawawi.
من راوي حديث «إنما الأعمال بالنيات»؟: Who narrated the Hadith «Actions are only by intentions»?
Umar narrated it from the pulpit. Agreed upon (Bukhari & Muslim).
أكمل: «إنما الأعمال بالنيات وإنما لكل ام: Complete: «Actions are only by intentions, and every person will only have …»
Every person is rewarded according to his intention.
أي حديث فيه أركان الإسلام والإيمان والإح: Which Hadith contains the pillars of Islam, faith and excellence (Ihsan)?
جاء جبريل عليه السلام في صورة رجل يسأل ا: Jibreel (peace be upon him) came in the form of a man and asked the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
كم أركان الإسلام في حديث «بُني الإسلام ع: How many pillars of Islam are there in the Hadith «Islam is built upon five»?
الشهادتان، والصلاة، والزكاة، والحج، وصوم: The two testimonies of faith, prayer, Zakat, Hajj, and fasting Ramadan.
من راوي حديث «بني الإسلام على خمس»؟: Who narrated the Hadith «Islam is built upon five»?
ما حكم من أحدث في الدين ما ليس منه؟: What is the ruling on someone who introduces into the religion something that is not part of it?
قال ﷺ: «من أحدث في أمرنا هذا ما ليس منه: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: «Whoever introduces into this matter of ours something that is not part of it, it is rejected», from the Hadith of Aisha.
ما معنى «الحلال بيّن والحرام بيّن»؟: What is the meaning of «The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear»?
أن أمور الحلال والحرام واضحة وبينهما أمو: That matters of the lawful and the unlawful are clear, and between them are doubtful matters
من اتقى الشبهات استبرأ لدينه وعرضه، والر: Whoever avoids doubtful matters has protected his religion and his honor. The narrator is An-Nu'man ibn Bashir.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ في حديث تميم الداري؟: What did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ say in the hadith of Tamim ad-Dari?
الدين المعاملة فقط: Religion is only dealing with others
النصيحة لله ولكتابه ولرسوله ولأئمة المسل: Sincere advice is for Allah, for His Book, for His Messenger, and for the leaders of the Muslims and their common people.
رتّب أسئلة جبريل في حديثه المشهور: Put Jibril's questions in order from his famous hadith
سأل جبريل عن الإسلام ثم الإيمان ثم الإحس: Jibril asked about Islam, then Iman (faith), then Ihsan (excellence), then the Hour.
The narrator is Anas ibn Malik, and the hadith is agreed upon (Bukhari & Muslim).
ما الدرس الرئيس في حديث «لا يؤمن أحدكم ح: What is the main lesson of the hadith “None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother”?
كمال الإيمان بمحبة الخير للناس: Perfecting faith by wishing good for people
المؤمن يحب لإخوانه من الخير ما يحب لنفسه: A believer loves for his brothers the good that he loves for himself.
ماذا يفعل من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر: According to the hadith, what does the one who believes in Allah and the Last Day do?
يقول خيرًا أو يصمت: Says something good or stays silent
رواه أبو هريرة، وفيه إكرام الجار والضيف: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah. It also mentions honoring the neighbor and the guest.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ لمن طلب الوصية؟: What did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ say to the one who asked for advice?
He repeated it several times. Narrated by Bukhari from Abu Hurayrah.
ما معنى «لا تغضب»؟: What does “Do not get angry” mean?
لا تنفّذ مقتضى الغضب من الأذى والإساءة: Do not act on anger by harming or mistreating others
المقصود ضبط النفس عند الغضب وتجنب أسبابه: It means controlling yourself when angry and avoiding its causes.
ما موضوع حديث «إن الله كتب الإحسان على ك: What is the topic of the hadith “Indeed, Allah has prescribed excellence in everything”?
Narrated by Muslim from Shaddad ibn Aws.
أكمل: «دع ما يريبك إلى …»: Complete: “Leave what makes you doubt for …”
ما لا يريبك: what does not make you doubt
الحديث عن الحسن بن علي، وفيه ترك الشك إل: The hadith is from al-Hasan ibn Ali; it tells us to leave doubt for certainty.
أكمل: «من حسن إسلام المرء تركه …»: Complete: “Part of the excellence of a person's Islam is his leaving …”
The hadith is from Abu Hurayrah; it speaks of leaving nosiness.
سمعت أن زميلك يتحدث عن أمر لا يخصك، فما: You heard that your classmate is talking about something that is none of your business. Which is closest to the hadith “what does not concern him”?
لا أتدخل فيما لا يعنيني: I do not get involved in what does not concern me
أنقل الكلام للآخرين: I pass the words on to others
Leaving nosiness is part of the perfection of Islam.
رتّب خطوات الإحسان في الذبح كما في الحدي: Put the steps of excellence in slaughtering in order, as in the hadith
الحديث فيه الأمر بإحسان الذبحة وإراحة ال: The hadith commands doing the slaughter well and giving the animal ease.
وصايا للقلب والسلوك: Counsels for the heart and conduct
The hadith is addressed to Abu Dharr and Mu'adh (may Allah be pleased with them both).
ما الذي يمحو السيئة كما في حديث «اتق الل: According to the hadith “Fear Allah wherever you are”, what wipes out a bad deed?
أن تتبعها بحسنة: Following it with a good deed
The Prophet ﷺ said: “And follow up a bad deed with a good deed, it will wipe it out.”
The hadith is from Abdullah ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both).
ما معنى «احفظ الله تجده تجاهك»؟: What does “Protect Allah and you will find Him before you” mean?
من حفظ حدود الله وجد عون الله: Whoever keeps Allah's limits finds Allah's help
من حفظ المال زاد غناه: Whoever keeps his money grows richer
Protecting Allah means obeying Him and avoiding disobedience to Him.
ماذا قال النبي ﷺ عن الطهور؟: What did the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ say about purification (Taharah)?
الراوي أبو مالك الأشعري، والحديث في صحيح: The narrator is Abu Malik al-Ash'ari, and the hadith is in Sahih Muslim.
ما معنى «الحمد لله تملأ الميزان»؟: What does “Alhamdulillah fills the scale” mean?
عظم ثواب الحمد: The greatness of the reward for praising Allah
الحمد يخص الأغنياء: Praising Allah is only for the rich
It comes in the same hadith, which mentions the virtue of Dhikr (remembrance of Allah).
ماذا تجاوز الله عنه لأمة محمد ﷺ؟: What did Allah overlook for the followers of Muhammad ﷺ?
الخطأ والنسيان وما استكرهوا عليه: Mistakes, forgetfulness, and what they are forced into
الحديث عن ابن عباس، ومعناه رفع الإثم عن: The hadith is from Ibn Abbas; it means sin is lifted for mistakes, forgetfulness, and coercion.
أكمل: «كن في الدنيا كأنك …»: Complete: “Be in this world as if you were …”
تاجر أو ثري: a merchant or a rich man
الراوي عبد الله بن عمر، وفيه الزهد في ال: The narrator is Abdullah ibn Umar; it speaks of detachment from this world.
ما معنى «لا ضرر ولا ضرار»؟: What does “There is no harm and no returning harm” mean?
لا يجوز إلحاق الأذى بالنفس ولا بالغير: It is not permitted to harm oneself or others
يجوز الأذى للمنفعة: Harm is allowed for the sake of benefit
يرويه أبو سعيد الخدري، وهو من القواعد ال: Narrated by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; it is one of the great principles of Islamic law (Shariah).
رتّب النصائح الواردة في حديث «اتق الله ح: Put the pieces of advice from the hadith “Fear Allah wherever you are” in order
أتبع السيئة الحسنة: Follow a bad deed with a good deed
هذه وصايا النبي ﷺ لأبي ذر ومعاذ رضي الله: These are the counsels of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ to Abu Dharr and Mu'adh (may Allah be pleased with them both).
ما أول وصف للمسلم في حديث «لا يحل دم امر: What is the first description of the Muslim in the hadith “The blood of a Muslim is not lawful to shed”?
عصمة دمه إلا بأحد أسباب ثلاثة: His blood is protected, except for one of three reasons
الراوي ابن مسعود، والأسباب: الثيب الزاني: The narrator is Ibn Mas'ud; the reasons are: the married adulterer, a life for a life, and the one who abandons his religion and separates from the community.
ما مراتب إنكار المنكر في الحديث؟: What are the levels of forbidding wrong in the hadith?
باليد ثم باللسان ثم بالقلب: By hand, then by tongue, then by heart
قال ﷺ: «من رأى منكم منكرًا فليغيّره بيده: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever among you sees a wrong, let him change it with his hand...” Narrated by Muslim from Abu Sa'id.
وأضعف الإيمان في مراتب إنكار المنكر هو …: And the weakest level of faith among the levels of forbidding wrong is …
And that is the weakest level of faith, as in the hadith.
ماذا يفعل الله لمن نفّس عن مؤمن كربة؟: What does Allah do for the one who relieves a believer of a hardship?
ينفّس عنه كربة من كرب يوم القيامة: He relieves him of a hardship on the Day of Resurrection

أقسام التوحيد وأنواع الشرك: The categories of Tawhid and the types of shirk
ما قسم التوحيد الذي يعني إفراد الله بأفع: Which category of Tawhid means singling out Allah in His own actions, such as creation, provision, and management of affairs?
أقسامه عند أهل السنة بالاستقراء: الربوبي: According to Ahl as-Sunnah, by study of the texts, its categories are: Lordship, Worship, and Names and Attributes.
يُسمّى توحيد الألوهية أيضًا:: Tawhid of Uluhiyyah is also called:
هو إفراد الله وحده بالعبادة كالدعاء والذ: It means singling out Allah alone for worship, such as supplication, sacrifice, vows, and reliance.
ما الذي يميّز موقف مشركي العرب الذين بُع: What distinguishes the position of the Arab polytheists among whom the Prophet ﷺ was sent?
أقرّوا بالربوبية وأشركوا في الألوهية: They affirmed Lordship but associated partners in worship
أنكروا وجود الخالق جملة: They denied the existence of a Creator altogether
أقرّوا بالألوهية وأنكروا الربوبية: They affirmed worship but denied Lordship
أقرّوا بالأسماء والصفات كلها على الوجه ا: They affirmed all the Names and Attributes correctly
«وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّم: “If you asked them who created the heavens and the earth, they would surely say, ‘Allah.’” (Luqman §).
ما القاعدة التي تجمعها آية «لَيْسَ كَمِث: What principle does the verse “There is nothing like Him, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing” establish regarding the Names and Attributes?
التنزيه عن المماثلة مع إثبات الصفات: Declaring Him free of resemblance while affirming the attributes
نفي الصفات تنزيهًا: Denying the attributes in order to glorify Him
إثبات الصفات مع تشبيهها بصفات المخلوقين: Affirming the attributes while likening them to creatures’ attributes
التوقف في معاني الصفات كلها: Suspending judgment on the meanings of all attributes
سورة الشورى §: نفي المماثلة في أولها وإث: Surah Ash-Shura §: resemblance is denied at the start, and hearing and seeing are affirmed at the end.
ماذا تعني عبارة «بلا تكييف» في إثبات الص: What does “without asking how” (bila kayf) mean in affirming attributes according to Ahl as-Sunnah?
عدم تحديد كيفية الصفة والسؤال عن هيئتها: Not specifying the manner of the attribute or asking about its form
عدم إثبات الصفة أصلًا: Not affirming the attribute at all
صرف لفظ الصفة إلى معنى آخر: Turning the wording of the attribute to another meaning
تشبيه الصفة بصفة المخلوق: Likening the attribute to a creature’s attribute
تُثبت الصفة ويُعلم معناها، وتُفوَّض كيفي: The attribute is affirmed and its meaning is known, while its manner is left to Allah.
ما حكم من مات على الشرك الأكبر دون توبة؟: What is the ruling on someone who dies upon major shirk without repenting?
يُغفر له إن كثرت حسناته: He is forgiven if his good deeds are many
يُعذَّب مدة ثم يخرج من النار: He is punished for a while, then leaves the Fire
يُعامل معاملة صاحب الكبيرة: He is treated like a person who committed a major sin
«إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ أَن يُشْرَكَ: “Indeed, Allah does not forgive association with Him, but He forgives what is less than that for whom He wills.” (An-Nisa §).
أي مما يلي يُعدّ شركًا أصغر؟: Which of the following counts as minor shirk?
الذبح لغير الله تقرّبًا: Sacrificing for other than Allah to draw near to it
دعاء الأموات لكشف الضر: Calling upon the dead to remove harm
قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إن أخوف م: The Prophet ﷺ said: “What I fear most for you is minor shirk.” He was asked about it and said: “Showing off.” (Narrated by Ahmad).
الحلف بغير الله عند أكثر أهل العلم هو في: Swearing by other than Allah, according to most scholars, is in principle:
شرك أصغر ما لم يعظّم المحلوف به كتعظيم ا: Minor shirk, unless the thing sworn by is glorified like Allah
مكروه كراهة تنزيه فقط: Only disliked, as a matter of courtesy
ورد: «من حلف بغير الله فقد كفر أو أشرك»: It is reported: “Whoever swears by other than Allah has committed disbelief or shirk” (At-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud). It is mostly understood as minor, unless one believes the thing is glorified equally to Allah.
ما حق الله على العباد كما في حديث معاذ ر: What is Allah’s right over His servants, as in the hadith of Mu‘adh (may Allah be pleased with him)?
أن يعبدوه ولا يشركوا به شيئًا: That they worship Him and associate nothing with Him
أن يقيموا الصلاة ويؤتوا الزكاة فقط: That they only establish prayer and give zakat
أن يتوكلوا عليه ويستغفروه: That they rely on Him and seek His forgiveness
أن يشكروه على نعمه ولا يسألوا غيره: That they thank Him for His blessings and ask no one else
متفق عليه، وفيه أن حق العباد على الله أل: Agreed upon (Bukhari & Muslim). It also states that the servants’ right over Allah is that He does not punish whoever associates nothing with Him.
أي من الآتي ذُكر في حديث أبي بكرة رضي ال: Which of the following is named as the greatest of the major sins in the hadith of Abu Bakrah (may Allah be pleased with him)?
«ألا أنبئكم بأكبر الكبائر؟ الإشراك بالله: “Shall I not tell you of the greatest of the major sins? Associating partners with Allah, disobeying parents, and false testimony.” (Agreed upon).
مراتب القدر والإيمان: The levels of Qadar and faith
ما الترتيب الصحيح لمراتب القدر الأربع؟: What is the correct order of the four levels of Qadar?
العلم ثم الكتابة ثم المشيئة ثم الخلق: Knowledge, then writing, then will, then creation
الكتابة ثم العلم ثم المشيئة ثم الخلق: Writing, then knowledge, then will, then creation
العلم ثم المشيئة ثم الكتابة ثم الخلق: Knowledge, then will, then writing, then creation
المشيئة ثم العلم ثم الخلق ثم الكتابة: Will, then knowledge, then creation, then writing
هذا ترتيب أهل السنة المشهور في الإيمان ب: This is the well-known order of Ahl as-Sunnah in believing in Qadar.
كم المدة التي ورد أن الله كتب فيها مقادي: How long before creating the heavens and the earth is it reported that Allah wrote down the decrees of creation?
«كتب الله مقادير الخلائق قبل أن يخلق الس: “Allah wrote down the decrees of creation fifty thousand years before creating the heavens and the earth.” (Narrated by Muslim).
أي مرتبة من مراتب القدر تدل عليها آية «و: Which level of Qadar does the verse “And you do not will except that Allah wills, Lord of the worlds” point to?
سورة التكوير §: مشيئة العباد تحت مشيئة ا: Surah At-Takwir §: people’s will is under Allah’s will.
أي مرتبة تدل عليها آية «وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ: Which level does the verse “And Allah created you and what you do” point to?
سورة الصافات §: أفعال العباد مخلوقة لله،: Surah As-Saffat §: people’s actions are created by Allah, and the servant has choice and acquisition in them.
أي مرتبتين تجمعهما آية «أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ: Which two levels does the verse “Do you not know that Allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record” combine?
Surah Al-Hajj §: all-encompassing knowledge and recording in a Book.
ما الفرقة التي زعمت أن العبد يخلق فعله ا: Which sect claimed that a person creates their own actions independently of Allah’s will?
أما الجبرية فغلت في الإثبات فنفت اختيار: As for the Jabriyyah, they went to an extreme in affirming Qadar and denied the servant’s choice; Ahl as-Sunnah take the middle way between the two groups.
ما حكم الاحتجاج بالقدر؟: What is the ruling on using Qadar as an argument?
لا يُحتج به على المعاصي ويُحتج به عند ال: It is not used to excuse sins, but it is invoked at times of calamity
يجوز الاحتجاج به على المعاصي: It is permissible to use it to excuse sins
لا يجوز الاحتجاج به مطلقًا: It is never permissible to use it
يجوز الاحتجاج به على المعاصي والمصائب مع: It is permissible to use it for both sins and calamities
يُؤمن به تسليمًا عند المصيبة، ويُتوب من: One believes in it with acceptance at times of calamity, and repents from sin without taking Qadar as an excuse for it.
ما تعريف الإيمان عند أهل السنة والجماعة؟: What is the definition of faith (Iman) according to Ahl as-Sunnah wal-Jama‘ah?
قول باللسان واعتقاد بالقلب وعمل بالجوارح: Speech of the tongue, belief of the heart, and action of the limbs
It increases with obedience and decreases with disobedience.
ما الذي تدل عليه آية «لِيَزْدَادُوا إِيم: What does the verse “that they may increase in faith along with their faith” indicate?
أن الإيمان تصديق لا يقبل التفاضل: That faith is belief that does not vary in degree
سورة الفتح §، وجاء مثلها في الأنفال § وغ: Surah Al-Fath §, and similar wording appears in Al-Anfal § and elsewhere.
ما أدنى شعب الإيمان كما في حديث «الإيمان: What is the lowest branch of faith in the hadith “Faith has over seventy branches”?
«أعلاها قول لا إله إلا الله، وأدناها إما: “The highest is saying ‘La ilaha illa Allah’, and the lowest is removing harm from the road, and modesty is a branch of faith.” (Agreed upon).
حديث جبريل: الإسلام والإيمان والإحسان: The hadith of Jibril: Islam, Iman and Ihsan
من راوي حديث جبريل المشهور في صحيح مسلم؟: Who narrated the famous hadith of Jibril in Sahih Muslim?
أبو هريرة رضي الله عنه: Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him)
أنس بن مالك رضي الله عنه: Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him)
عبد الله بن عباس رضي الله عنهما: Abdullah ibn ‘Abbas (may Allah be pleased with them both)
Al-Bukhari also narrated it from Abu Hurayrah.
أي ركن ذُكر أولًا في جواب «ما الإسلام؟»: Which pillar is mentioned first in the answer to “What is Islam?” in the hadith?
شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدًا رسول: The testimony that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah
ثم الصلاة والزكاة والصوم والحج لمن استطا: Then prayer, zakat, fasting, and Hajj for whoever is able to make the journey.
أي مما يلي ليس من أركان الإيمان الستة؟: Which of the following is not one of the six pillars of faith?
الإيمان بالقدر خيره وشره: Belief in Qadar, its good and its bad
الستة: الله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله واليوم: The six: Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day, and Qadar, its good and its bad.
كيف عرّف النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الإحسا: How did the Prophet ﷺ define Ihsan?
أن تعبد الله خوفًا من عذابه فقط: To worship Allah only out of fear of His punishment
أن تتقن العمل لتنال أجرة الدنيا: To do a job well in order to earn worldly wages
أن تُكثر من النوافل بعد الفرائض: To do many voluntary acts after the obligatory ones
It is the highest of the three levels of the religion.
ما الذي قاله النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about the question “When is the Hour?”
«ما المسؤول عنها بأعلم من السائل»: “The one being asked knows no more than the one asking.”
«بعد ألف سنة من بعثتي»: “After a thousand years from my sending.”
«إذا ظهرت الفتن تقوم الساعة»: “The Hour will come when tribulations appear.”
«يعلمها جبريل ولا أعلمها»: “Jibril knows it, and I do not.”
The Hour is among the unseen that Allah has kept to Himself.
أي مما يلي ذُكر في حديث جبريل من أمارات: Which of the following is mentioned in the hadith of Jibril among the signs of the Hour?
أن يتطاول رعاة الشاء في البنيان: Shepherds competing in constructing tall buildings
نزول عيسى ابن مريم: The descent of Isa, son of Maryam
ومنها: «أن تلد الأمة ربتها»، وهي من العل: Among them: “that the slave woman gives birth to her mistress,” which is one of the minor signs.
من السائل في الحديث وما شأنه؟: Who was the questioner in the hadith, and what was his purpose?
جبريل عليه السلام جاء يعلّم الصحابة دينه: Jibril (peace be upon him), who came to teach the Companions their religion
رجل من الصحابة: A man from among the Companions
He said: “That was Jibril; he came to teach you your religion.”
كيف وُصف الرجل السائل في أول الحديث؟: How was the questioner described at the beginning of the hadith?
شديد بياض الثياب شديد سواد الشعر لا يُرى: Intensely white clothes, intensely black hair, no sign of travel on him, and none of us knew him
عليه أثر السفر ويعرفه الصحابة: Signs of travel on him, and the Companions knew him
وهذا مما أشكل على الصحابة حتى أخبرهم الن: This was puzzling to the Companions until the Prophet told them who he was.
ما أعلى مراتب الدين الثلاث في الحديث؟: Which is the highest of the three levels of the religion in the hadith?
قال العلماء: كل مرتبة أخص مما قبلها، فال: The scholars said: each level is more specific than the one before, and Ihsan is the most specific.
إذا اجتمع لفظا الإسلام والإيمان في نص وا: When the words “Islam” and “Iman” appear together in one text, the well-known view of the scholars is that:
الإسلام يُفسَّر بالأعمال الظاهرة والإيما: Islam is explained by outward actions and Iman by inward matters
الإيمان للأعمال الظاهرة والإسلام للباطنة: Iman is for outward actions and Islam for inward ones
الإسلام لغير العرب والإيمان للعرب: Islam is for non-Arabs and Iman for Arabs
معناهما واحد دائمًا: They always mean the same thing
ويُقال: إذا اجتمعا افترقا، وإذا افترقا ا: It is said: when they come together they differ in meaning, and when they are separate they share meaning, as in the hadith of Jibril.
أشراط الساعة والبرزخ والقيامة: Signs of the Hour, the Barzakh and the Resurrection
ما آخر الأشراط الكبرى المذكورة في حديث ح: What is the last of the major signs mentioned in the hadith of Hudhayfah ibn Asid (may Allah be pleased with him)?
نار تخرج من اليمن تطرد الناس إلى المحشر: A fire coming out of Yemen that drives people to the place of gathering
رواه مسلم، وذكر فيه الدخان والدجال والدا: Narrated by Muslim. It mentions the smoke, the Dajjal, the Beast, the sun, Isa, Gog and Magog, and three landslides.
أين ينزل عيسى ابن مريم عليه السلام كما ف: Where does Isa, son of Maryam (peace be upon him), descend, as in the hadith of an-Nawwas ibn Sam‘an?
عند المنارة البيضاء شرقي دمشق: By the white minaret east of Damascus
أين يدرك عيسى عليه السلام الدجال فيقتله؟: Where does Isa (peace be upon him) catch up with the Dajjal and kill him?
عند باب الكعبة: At the door of the Ka‘bah
This is reported in Sahih Muslim.
ما حال الإيمان والتوبة بعد طلوع الشمس من: What is the status of faith and repentance after the sun rises from the west?
لا ينفع نفسًا إيمانها لم تكن آمنت من قبل: A soul’s faith will not benefit it if it had not believed before
تُقبل التوبة سبعين سنة: Repentance is accepted for seventy years
تُقبل التوبة من المؤمنين فقط: Repentance is accepted only from believers
تُقبل التوبة إلى قيام الساعة: Repentance is accepted until the Hour begins
ذكر ذلك الحديث المتفق عليه وآية الأنعام: This is stated in the agreed-upon hadith and in the verse of Al-An‘am §.
الحاجز بين الموت والبعث: The barrier between death and resurrection
ما بين النفختين فقط: Only the time between the two Blasts
موضع الحساب يوم القيامة: The place of reckoning on the Day of Resurrection
«وَمِن وَرَائِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ: “And behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.” (Al-Mu’minun §).
في أي شيء نزلت آية «يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ ال: What was the verse “Allah keeps firm those who believe with the firm word” revealed about, as in the two Sahihs?
في عذاب القبر وسؤال الملكين: The punishment of the grave and the questioning of the two angels
ما أثقل ما يوضع في الميزان كما ورد في ال: What is the heaviest thing placed on the Scale, as mentioned in the hadith?
«ما من شيء أثقل في ميزان المؤمن يوم القي: “Nothing is heavier on the believer’s Scale on the Day of Resurrection than good character.” (At-Tirmidhi and Abu Dawud).
كيف وُصف ماء حوض النبي صلى الله عليه وسل: How is the water of the Prophet’s ﷺ Basin described in the hadith?
أبيض من اللبن وريحه أطيب من المسك: Whiter than milk and its scent better than musk
أصفى من الثلج وأبرد من الزمهرير: Clearer than snow and colder than ice
أخضر كالزمرد وطعمه كالشهد: Green like emerald and tasting like honeycomb
رواه البخاري ومسلم من حديث عبد الله بن ع: Narrated by al-Bukhari and Muslim from the hadith of Abdullah ibn ‘Amr.
جسر منصوب على متن جهنم يمر عليه الناس: A bridge set up over Hell that people cross
ميزان توزن به الأعمال: A scale on which deeds are weighed
ممر بين الجنة والبرزخ: A passage between Paradise and the Barzakh
سور بين الجنة والنار فقط: Only a wall between Paradise and the Fire
ثبت وصفه في حديث أبي سعيد الخدري المتفق: Its description is established in the agreed-upon hadith of Abu Sa‘id al-Khudri.
ما المقام المحمود الذي وُعد به النبي صلى: What is the “Praised Station” promised to the Prophet ﷺ in the verse “It may be that your Lord will raise you to a Praised Station”?
الشفاعة العظمى في أهل الموقف: The greatest intercession for the people of the gathering
الشفاعة لأهل الكبائر فقط: Intercession for the people of major sins only
هذا تفسير جمهور المفسرين، سورة الإسراء §: This is the interpretation of the majority of commentators, Surah Al-Isra §.
الأحكام التكليفية والمصادر والقواعد الكب: Legal rulings, sources, and the major maxims
ما الحكم الذي يُثاب فاعله ولا يُعاقب تار: Which ruling is rewarded for doing it and not punished for leaving it?
الأحكام التكليفية الخمسة: الواجب والمندو: The five rulings: obligatory, recommended, permissible, disliked, and forbidden.
ما الحكم الذي يُثاب تاركه امتثالًا ولا ي: Which ruling is rewarded for leaving it out of obedience and not punished for doing it?
أما الحرام فيُعاقب فاعله ويُثاب تاركه ام: As for the forbidden, the one who does it is punished and the one who leaves it out of obedience is rewarded.
كيف يُنظر إلى الفرض والواجب عند جمهور ال: How do the majority of scholars of legal theory view fard and wajib?
الفرض أدنى رتبة من الواجب: Fard is lower in rank than wajib
الواجب أعلى رتبة دائمًا: Wajib is always higher in rank
الفرض في العبادات والواجب في المعاملات: Fard is for acts of worship and wajib for transactions
والحنفية يفرّقون بينهما بحسب قطعية الدلي: The Hanafis distinguish between them according to how certain the evidence is.
أي مما يلي ليس من الأدلة المتفق عليها عن: Which of the following is not one of the evidences agreed upon by the four Imams?
المتفق عليه: الكتاب والسنة والإجماع والق: Agreed upon: the Book, the Sunnah, consensus, and analogy. The Zahiris disagreed on analogy, and there is disagreement over juristic preference, public interest, and others.
أي القواعد الخمس الكبرى تعني الرجوع إلى: Which of the five major maxims means referring to custom when there is no text?
اليقين لا يزول بالشك: Certainty is not removed by doubt
An example is determining maintenance according to what is customary.
في قياس النبيذ المسكر على الخمر في التحر: In the analogy of intoxicating nabidh to wine regarding prohibition, what is the shared cause?
أركان القياس: الأصل والفرع وحكم الأصل وا: The pillars of analogy: the original case, the new case, the ruling of the original case, and the cause.
أي قاعدة كبرى دليلها حديث «إنما الأعمال: Which major maxim is based on the hadith “Deeds are only by intentions”?
الأمور بمقاصدها: Matters are judged by their intentions
Agreed upon from the hadith of ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him).
أي قاعدة كبرى دليلها حديث «لا ضرر ولا ضر: Which major maxim is based on the hadith “There is to be no harm and no reciprocating harm”?
رواه ابن ماجه وأحمد، وله شواهد وحسّنه جم: Narrated by Ibn Majah and Ahmad. It has supporting narrations and a group of scholars graded it hasan.
من تيقّن الطهارة ثم شكّ هل أحدث، فبناءً: Someone is certain of being in a state of purity and then doubts whether they broke it. Based on the maxim “Certainty is not removed by doubt”, he:
يبني على أنه متطهر: Proceeds on the basis that he is pure
يصلي ثم يعيد احتياطًا: Prays, then repeats as a precaution
«لا ينصرف حتى يسمع صوتًا أو يجد ريحًا» (: “He should not leave until he hears a sound or smells something.” (Agreed upon).
أي مما يلي من تطبيقات قاعدة «المشقة تجلب: Which of the following is an application of the maxim “Hardship brings ease”?
القصر والجمع في السفر والمسح على الخفين: Shortening and combining prayers while travelling, and wiping over leather socks
إلزام المريض بالقيام في الفريضة: Forcing a sick person to stand in the obligatory prayer
تأخير الصلاة إلى ما بعد وقتها: Delaying prayer until after its time
منع الفطر على المريض مطلقًا: Forbidding a sick person from breaking the fast in all cases
«يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ بِكُمُ الْيُسْرَ وَلَا: “Allah intends for you ease and does not intend for you hardship.” (Al-Baqarah §).
أئمة المذاهب الأربعة وأحكام الصلاة: The four Imams of the schools and the rulings of prayer
أي الأئمة الأربعة توفي سنة § هـ؟: Which of the four Imams died in the year § AH?
He was born in the year § AH in Kufa and died in Baghdad.
أي الأئمة وُلد في المدينة وتوفي بها سنة: Which Imam was born in Madinah and died there in the year § AH?
ولادته سنة § هـ على المشهور، وكتابه المو: He was born in the year § AH according to the well-known view, and his book is al-Muwatta’.
أين وفي أي سنة توفي الإمام الشافعي؟: Where and in what year did Imam ash-Shafi‘i die?
بمصر سنة § هـ: In Egypt in the year § AH
بالمدينة سنة § هـ: In Madinah in the year § AH
ببغداد سنة § هـ: In Baghdad in the year § AH
بالكوفة سنة § هـ: In Kufa in the year § AH
He was born in the year § AH in Gaza according to the well-known view.
أي الكتب ينسب إلى الشافعي على أنه أول مص: Which book is attributed to ash-Shafi‘i as the first well-known work on the principles of jurisprudence?
Among his other famous books is also “Al-Umm”.
من الإمام الذي امتُحن في فتنة خلق القرآن: Which Imam was tested in the trial of the “creation of the Qur’an” and stood firm through it?
وُلد سنة § هـ ببغداد وتوفي بها سنة § هـ،: He was born in the year § AH in Baghdad and died there in the year § AH, and he authored “Al-Musnad”.
من تلميذا أبي حنيفة المشهوران؟: Who were the two famous students of Abu Hanifah?
أبو يوسف ومحمد بن الحسن: Abu Yusuf and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan
صالح وعبد الله ابنا أحمد: Salih and Abdullah, the sons of Ahmad
They are the ones who spread his knowledge and recorded the school’s positions.
عمّن أخذ الإمام الشافعي العلم في المدينة: From whom did Imam ash-Shafi‘i take knowledge in Madinah?
He recited al-Muwatta’ to him in Madinah.
أي مما يلي من شروط الصلاة لا من أركانها؟: Which of the following is a condition of prayer, not a pillar?
الشروط: الطهارة وستر العورة ودخول الوقت: The conditions: purification, covering the awrah, the time having entered, facing the Qibla, and intention.
أي مما يلي من أركان الصلاة المتفق عليها؟: Which of the following is an agreed-upon pillar of prayer?
الثلاثة الأخرى شروط، والركوع والسجود ركن: The other three are conditions; bowing and prostration are two pillars by agreement.
متى يبدأ وقت صلاة الظهر؟: When does the time of the Dhuhr prayer begin?
إذا زالت الشمس عن وسط السماء: When the sun passes its zenith
إذا صار ظل كل شيء مثليه: When the shadow of everything becomes twice its length
عند طلوع الفجر الصادق: At the break of true dawn
ويمتد إلى أن يصير ظل كل شيء مثله سوى فيء: It lasts until the shadow of everything equals its length, apart from the shadow at noon (hadith of Jibril on prayer).
أنصبة الزكاة وأركان الحج وواجباته: Zakat thresholds and the pillars and obligations of Hajj
كم نصاب الذهب في الزكاة؟: What is the zakat threshold (nisab) for gold?
والمقدار الواجب ربع العشر، وتقدير الغرام: The amount due is one-fortieth (2.5%); the gram figures are approximations used by contemporary scholars.
كم نصاب الفضة في الزكاة؟: What is the zakat threshold (nisab) for silver?
«ليس فيما دون خمس أواق صدقة» (متفق عليه): “There is no zakat on less than five awqiyah.” (Agreed upon). It is estimated at about § grams.
ما مقدار الزكاة في الذهب والفضة وعروض ال: How much zakat is due on gold, silver, and trade goods?
On condition that the threshold is reached and a full lunar year has passed.
ما الواجب فيما سُقي بماء السماء أو الأنه: What is due on grains and fruits watered by rain or rivers?
وما سُقي بآلة أو مؤنة ففيه نصف العشر (ال: What is watered by a device or effort is subject to one-twentieth (al-Bukhari).
ماذا يجب في خمس من الإبل؟: What is due on five camels?
بنت مخاض: A she-camel in her second year
في كل خمس من الإبل شاة إلى أربع وعشرين،: For every five camels, one sheep, up to twenty-four; then a second-year she-camel at twenty-five.
ما أول نصاب الغنم وما الواجب فيه؟: What is the first threshold for sheep and what is due on it?
أربعون وفيها شاة: Forty, and one sheep is due
ثلاثون وفيها شاة: Thirty, and one sheep is due
خمس وعشرون وفيها بنت مخاض: Twenty-five, and a second-year she-camel is due
مئة وفيها شاتان: One hundred, and two sheep are due
Then at one hundred and twenty-one, two sheep are due.
كم الواجب في الركاز؟: How much is due on buried treasure (rikaz)?
أي مما يلي من أركان الحج؟: Which of the following is a pillar of Hajj?
«الحج عرفة» (رواه أصحاب السنن). والبقية: “Hajj is ‘Arafah.” (Narrated by the authors of the Sunan). The others are obligations according to the majority.
أي مما يلي واجب من واجبات الحج لا ركن؟: Which of the following is an obligation (wajib) of Hajj, not a pillar?
طواف الوداع لغير المكي: The farewell tawaf for non-residents of Makkah
والأركان عند الجمهور: الإحرام والوقوف بع: The pillars according to the majority: ihram, standing at ‘Arafah, tawaf al-ifadah, and sa‘i (an obligation according to the Hanafis).
ما ميقات أهل المدينة المكاني؟: What is the miqat for the people of Madinah?
الجحفة للشام، وقرن لأهل نجد، ويلملم لأهل: Al-Juhfah is for people of Sham, Qarn is for people of Najd, and Yalamlam for people of Yemen (agreed upon).
أنصبة المواريث وأنواع الربا: Inheritance shares and types of riba
كم نصيب الزوج من تركة زوجته إذا لم يكن ل: What is the husband’s share of his wife’s estate if she has no child or son’s child?
If she has a child, he receives one-quarter (An-Nisa §).
كم فرض الأم مع وجود الولد؟: What is the mother’s share when there is a child?
وترث السدس كذلك مع جمع من الإخوة، وإلا ف: She also receives one-sixth when there are several siblings; otherwise she receives one-third if there is no child and no siblings.
كم نصيب البنت الواحدة المنفردة التي لا ش: What is the share of a single daughter who has no other children as co-heirs?
«لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنثَيَيْنِ»: “The male receives the equivalent of two females’ share,” and for two or more daughters, two-thirds (An-Nisa §).
كم فرض الأب إذا كان للميت ولد ذكر؟: What is the father’s share if the deceased has a son?
«وَلِأَبَوَيْهِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُم: “And for his parents, to each one of them is a sixth of what he left, if he had a child.” (An-Nisa §).
ما العول في الفرائض؟: What is ‘awl in the laws of inheritance?
زيادة السهام على أصل المسألة فينقص نصيب: Shares exceeding the origin of the problem, so each heir’s share is reduced
زيادة الباقي على أصحاب الفروض: The remainder being returned to the fixed-share heirs
حجب وارث بوارث أقرب: An heir being excluded by a nearer heir
انتقال الإرث إلى بيت المال: The inheritance passing to the public treasury
أما الرد فهو زيادة الباقي على أصحاب الفر: As for radd, it is returning the remainder to the fixed-share heirs.
أي مما يلي مانع من موانع الإرث؟: Which of the following is an impediment to inheritance?
«لا يرث المسلم الكافر ولا الكافر المسلم»: “A Muslim does not inherit from a disbeliever, nor a disbeliever from a Muslim.” (Agreed upon). Killing is also an impediment.
ما أكثر ما تجوز به الوصية دون إجازة الور: What is the most that a will may cover without the heirs’ permission?
«الثلث، والثلث كثير» (متفق عليه من حديث: “One-third, and one-third is a lot.” (Agreed upon, from the hadith of Sa‘d).
بيع صاع تمر جيد بصاعين من التمر الرديء ي: Selling one sa‘ of good dates for two sa‘ of poor dates, hand to hand, is which type of riba?
قال النبي: «بع الجمع بالدراهم ثم ابتع با: The Prophet said: “Sell the mixed dates for dirhams, then buy good dates with the dirhams.” (Agreed upon). Riba al-fadl is excess within the same kind.
أي صورة تُعدّ من ربا النسيئة؟: Which transaction counts as riba an-nasi’ah?
بيع ذهب بفضة مع تأخير القبض في المجلس: Selling gold for silver with delayed possession after leaving the session
بيع ذهب بذهب يدًا بيد مثلًا بمثل: Selling gold for gold hand to hand, equal for equal
بيع ذهب بفضة يدًا بيد: Selling gold for silver hand to hand
بيع ذهب بسلعة غير ربوية مؤجلًا: Selling gold for a non-ribawi good on deferred payment
«الذهب بالفضة ربا إلا هاء وهاء» (متفق عل: “Gold for silver is riba unless it is hand to hand.” (Agreed upon).
ما الأصناف الستة المذكورة في حديث عبادة: What are the six items mentioned in the hadith of ‘Ubadah ibn as-Samit on riba?
الذهب والفضة والبر والشعير والتمر والملح: Gold, silver, wheat, barley, dates, and salt
الذهب والفضة والأرز والشعير والتمر والمل: Gold, silver, rice, barley, dates, and salt
الذهب والفضة والبر والعسل والتمر والزيت: Gold, silver, wheat, honey, dates, and oil
الذهب والفضة والبر والشعير والزبيب والسك: Gold, silver, wheat, barley, raisins, and sugar
رواه مسلم، وقد اختلف العلماء في علة التح: Narrated by Muslim. The scholars differed over the reason for the prohibition and over extending it to other items.
ما تعريف «الحديث» عند المحدثين؟: What is the definition of “hadith” according to the hadith scholars?
ما أُضيف إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم من: What is attributed to the Prophet ﷺ of speech, action, approval, or description
ما رواه الصحابة عن بعضهم من أقوال وأفعال: What the Companions narrated from one another of sayings and actions
ما نزل به الوحي من القرآن خاصة: What came by revelation, specifically the Qur’an
ما أُضيف إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم من: What is attributed to the Prophet ﷺ of speech only
هذا هو التعريف المشهور في كتب مصطلح الحد: This is the well-known definition in books of hadith terminology, and it includes physical and moral descriptions.
ما المراد بـ«السنة» في اصطلاح المحدثين؟: What is meant by “Sunnah” in the terminology of hadith scholars?
ما أُثر عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم من ق: What is reported from the Prophet ﷺ of speech, action, approval, or physical or moral description
ما يثاب فاعله ولا يعاقب تاركه فحسب: Only what is rewarded when done and not punished when left
ما أجمع عليه علماء المدينة: What the scholars of Madinah agreed upon
ما رواه الصحابة عن الخلفاء الراشدين: What the Companions narrated from the Rightly Guided Caliphs
وللفقهاء والأصوليين اصطلاح آخر، فهي عنده: Jurists and scholars of legal theory have another usage: for them it is the recommended ruling or a legal evidence other than the Qur’an.
أي المصطلحات يُطلق على ما جاء عن النبي ص: Which term is used for what came from the Prophet ﷺ and from others among the Companions and Followers, and is broader than “hadith” in usage according to some?
يرى بعض العلماء أن الخبر أعم من الحديث،: Some scholars hold that khabar is broader than hadith, while others hold they are synonyms.
ما «الأثر» عند كثير من المحدثين؟: What is an “athar” according to many hadith scholars?
ما رُوي عن الصحابة والتابعين من أقوال وأ: What is reported from the Companions and Followers of sayings and actions
ما رُوي بإسناد متصل إلى النبي صلى الله ع: What is narrated with a connected chain to the Prophet ﷺ only
ما أجمع على صحته أهل الحديث: What the hadith scholars agreed is authentic
ما رواه راوٍ واحد وانفرد به: What a single narrator reported and was alone in reporting
ومنهم من يطلق الأثر على المرفوع أيضًا، و: Some also use “athar” for what is traced to the Prophet ﷺ; the matter is one of terminology.
سلسلة الرواة الموصلة إلى المتن: The chain of narrators leading to the text
ألفاظ الحديث التي تقوم بها المعاني: The wording of the hadith through which meanings are formed
كتاب جمع فيه المؤلف أحاديث الصحابي الواح: A book in which the author gathered the hadiths of a single Companion
الحكم على الحديث بالصحة أو الضعف: Judging a hadith as authentic or weak
سمي سندًا لاعتماد الحفاظ عليه في معرفة ص: It is called “sanad” because the hadith experts rely on it to determine a hadith’s authenticity. Ibn al-Mubarak said: the isnad is part of the religion; without it, anyone could say whatever they wished (Introduction to Sahih Muslim).
ما «المتن» في الحديث؟: What is the “matn” of a hadith?
ألفاظ الحديث التي تتقوم بها المعاني: The wording of the hadith through which meanings are formed
اسم الراوي الأول للحديث: The name of the first narrator of the hadith
سلسلة الرواة من المصنف إلى الصحابي: The chain of narrators from the compiler to the Companion
شرح العلماء للحديث وبيان غريبه: Scholars’ explanation of the hadith and clarifying its difficult words
The matn is the speech at which the chain ends.
من «المخرِّج» للحديث؟: Who is the “mukharrij” of a hadith?
من ذكر الحديث في كتابه بإسناده: Someone who mentions the hadith in his book with its chain
من حكم على الحديث بالصحة: Someone who judged the hadith as authentic
من سمع الحديث مباشرة من النبي صلى الله ع: Someone who heard the hadith directly from the Prophet ﷺ
من شرح متن الحديث وبيّن غريبه: Someone who explained the text of the hadith and clarified its difficult words
كقولهم: «رواه البخاري» أو «أخرجه مسلم»،: Like their saying “Narrated by al-Bukhari” or “Reported by Muslim”. Takhrij is attributing a hadith to its sources.
ما تعريف «الصحابي» عند جمهور المحدثين؟: What is the definition of a “Companion” (Sahabi) according to the majority of hadith scholars?
من لقي النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مؤمنًا ب: Someone who met the Prophet ﷺ as a believer in him and died as a Muslim
من عاصر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ولم يره: Someone who lived in the Prophet’s ﷺ time but never saw him
من أسلم قبل الهجرة وهاجر إلى المدينة: Someone who became Muslim before the Hijrah and migrated to Madinah
من روى عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عشرة: Someone who narrated ten or more hadiths from the Prophet ﷺ
هذا تعريف ابن حجر في «نخبة الفكر» وغيره،: This is the definition of Ibn Hajar in “Nukhbat al-Fikar” and others, and it includes anyone who saw him even without long companionship.
من لقي صحابيًا مؤمنًا به ومات على الإسلا: Someone who met a Companion as a believer and died as a Muslim
من عاصر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وأسلم ب: Someone who lived in the Prophet’s ﷺ time and became Muslim after his death
من روى عن تابعي آخر: Someone who narrated from another Follower
من حفظ القرآن في عهد الصحابة: Someone who memorized the Qur’an in the time of the Companions
ومن أدرك الجاهلية والإسلام ولم يلقَ النب: Someone who lived through both the Jahiliyyah and Islam but did not meet the Prophet ﷺ, like Abu ‘Uthman an-Nahdi, is called a mukhadram.
ما اسم الحديث الذي يُنسب إلى الصحابي من: What is the name of a hadith attributed to a Companion, from his words or actions?
المرفوع ما أُضيف إلى النبي صلى الله عليه: Marfu‘ is what is attributed to the Prophet ﷺ, mawquf what is attributed to a Companion, and maqtu‘ what is attributed to a Follower or those after him.
أقسام الخبر والصحيح والحسن: Types of reports, and the sahih and hasan
ما رواه جمع تحيل العادة تواطؤهم على الكذ: What was narrated by a group whom it is customarily impossible to imagine agreeing on a lie, from a similar group, to its end
ما رواه ثلاثة فأكثر في كل طبقة دون بلوغ: What was narrated by three or more at every level without reaching mutawatir
ما رواه راوٍ واحد في طبقة من طبقات السند: What was narrated by a single narrator at one level of the chain
ما رواه اثنان فقط في كل طبقة: What was narrated by only two at every level
يفيد العلم الضروري عند جمهور العلماء، وه: It gives necessary knowledge according to the majority of scholars, and the preferred view is that it is not tied to a specific number.
ما حديث الآحاد؟: What is a khabar ahad (single-narrator report)?
ما لم تتوفر فيه شروط التواتر: What does not meet the conditions of mutawatir
ما رواه راوٍ واحد فقط في كل طبقة: What was narrated by only one narrator at every level
ما كان ضعيفًا لا يُحتج به: What was weak and cannot be used as evidence
قد يرويه جمع من الرواة ويبقى آحادًا ما ل: It may be narrated by a group of narrators and still remain ahad unless it reaches the level of tawatur; this includes the mashhur, ‘aziz, and gharib.
ما حكم العمل بخبر الآحاد الصحيح عند جمهو: What is the ruling on acting on an authentic single-narrator report according to the majority of scholars?
حجة يجب العمل بها: It is evidence that must be acted upon
لا يُعمل به إلا إذا بلغ التواتر: It is not acted upon unless it reaches tawatur
يُعمل به في فضائل الأعمال فقط: It is acted upon only for the virtues of deeds
يُعمل به إذا وافق عمل أهل المدينة فقط: It is acted upon only if it agrees with the practice of the people of Madinah
عمل الصحابة والأئمة على الاحتجاج بأخبار: The Companions and Imams acted upon single-narrator reports in rulings, and this is the view of the majority.
ما «المشهور» (المستفيض) عند كثير من المح: What is the “mashhur” (mustafid) according to many hadith scholars?
ما رواه ثلاثة فأكثر في كل طبقة ولم يبلغ: What was narrated by three or more at every level and did not reach mutawatir
ما انتشر على ألسنة العامة ولو لم يصح: What became widespread on people’s tongues, even if not authentic
ما رواه اثنان في كل طبقة: What was narrated by two at every level
ما اتفق عليه الشيخان: What the two Shaykhs agreed upon
والمشهور اصطلاحًا قد يكون صحيحًا أو ضعيف: Mashhur in the technical sense may be authentic or weak, and it is different from what is merely well known among people.
ما لا يقل رواته عن اثنين في جميع طبقات ا: What has no fewer than two narrators at every level of the chain
ما رواه راوٍ واحد في أي طبقة: What was narrated by a single narrator at any level
ما كثرت طرقه حتى بلغ التواتر: What has so many routes that it reached tawatur
ما ثبتت صحته بإجماع المحدثين: What is established as authentic by the consensus of hadith scholars
سمي عزيزًا لقلة وجوده أو لقوته بمجيئه من: It is called ‘aziz because of how rare it is, or because it is strengthened by coming through another route.
ما «الغريب» في اصطلاح المحدثين؟: What is the “gharib” in the terminology of hadith scholars?
ما انفرد بروايته راوٍ واحد: What only one narrator was alone in narrating
ما كان في ألفاظه كلمات غير مألوفة فقط: What only has unfamiliar words in its wording
ما رواه ضعيف لا يتابعه غيره: What a weak narrator narrated without anyone corroborating him
ما سقط من سنده راوٍ: What has a narrator missing from its chain
ويسمى أيضًا الفرد، وقد يكون صحيحًا كحديث: It is also called “fard”, and it can be authentic, like the hadith “Deeds are only by intentions”, which Yahya ibn Sa‘id al-Ansari alone narrated from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim at-Taymi from ‘Alqamah from ‘Umar, at the first levels of its chain.
أي هذه ليست من شروط الحديث الصحيح الخمسة: Which of these is not one of the five conditions of an authentic hadith?
الشروط: اتصال السند، وعدالة الرواة، وتما: The conditions: connected chain, integrity of narrators, complete precision, freedom from irregularity, and freedom from a damaging hidden defect.
مخالفة الراوي المقبول لمن هو أولى منه: An acceptable narrator contradicting someone more reliable than him
انفراد الراوي بحديث لم يروه غيره مطلقًا: A narrator being alone in narrating a hadith that no one else narrated at all
سقوط راوٍ من وسط السند: A narrator missing from the middle of the chain
اختلاط الراوي في آخر عمره: A narrator’s memory becoming confused late in life
مخالفة الثقة لمن هو أوثق منه أو أكثر عدد: A trustworthy narrator contradicting someone more trustworthy or more numerous. It is not merely being alone in narrating.
ما «العلة» عند المحدثين؟: What is the “‘illah” (hidden defect) according to hadith scholars?
سبب خفي غامض يقدح في صحة الحديث مع أن ظا: A hidden, subtle cause that damages a hadith’s authenticity even though it appears sound
ظاهر الضعف في الراوي كالكذب: An obvious weakness in a narrator, such as lying
كل مخالفة للقياس في المتن: Any contradiction of analogy in the text
انقطاع ظاهر في السند: An obvious break in the chain
ولا يدركها إلا الحفاظ الجهابذة، ولهم فيه: Only the master memorizers can perceive it, and they wrote books of “‘ilal”, such as the ‘Ilal of Ibn Abi Hatim and the ‘Ilal of ad-Daraqutni.
حديث ضعيف ضعفًا يسيرًا ارتقى بتعدد طرقه: A slightly weak hadith that is raised by multiple routes
حديث صحيح خف ضبط راويه: An authentic hadith whose narrator’s precision was slightly lower
حديث رواه البخاري خارج صحيحه: A hadith that al-Bukhari narrated outside his Sahih
حديث شهد له الإجماع دون إسناد: A hadith supported by consensus without a chain
يشترط ألا يكون ضعفه شديدًا كالكذب، وأن ت: Its weakness must not be severe, such as lying, and its acceptable routes must be many.
المرسل والمنقطع والموضوع والتدليس والجرح: Mursal, munqati‘, fabricated, tadlis, and criticism
ما «المرسل» في اصطلاح المحدثين؟: What is the “mursal” in the terminology of hadith scholars?
ما رفعه التابعي إلى النبي صلى الله عليه: What a Follower attributes to the Prophet ﷺ, omitting the Companion
ما سقط من إسناده راويان فأكثر على التوال: What has two or more consecutive narrators missing from its chain
ما حُذف من أول إسناده راوٍ فأكثر: What has one or more narrators removed from the beginning of its chain
ما رواه الصحابي عن صحابي آخر: What a Companion narrated from another Companion
كقول سعيد بن المسيب: قال رسول الله صلى ا: Like Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyib saying: “The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said.” It is considered weak by the majority because the omitted narrator is unknown.
ما سقط من وسط إسناده راوٍ أو أكثر مع عدم: What has one or more narrators missing from the middle of its chain, non-consecutively
ما رواه التابعي عن النبي صلى الله عليه و: What a Follower narrates directly from the Prophet ﷺ
ما حُذف مبدأ إسناده كله: What has the entire start of its chain removed
ما انفرد به راوٍ ضعيف: What a weak narrator alone narrated
وللمنقطع إطلاقات أخرى عند المتقدمين، وال: The earlier scholars used “munqati‘” in other ways; the well-known usage among later scholars is as stated.
ما سقط منه راوٍ واحد من أول السند: What has one narrator missing from the start of the chain
ما سقط منه الصحابي فقط: What has only the Companion missing
ما فيه راوٍ مدلس: What contains a narrator who practiced tadlis
سمي معضلًا من «أعضله» إذا أعياه؛ فهو أشد: It is called “mu‘dal” from “a‘dalahu”, meaning it exhausted him; it is weaker than the mursal and the munqati‘.
ما حُذف من مبدأ إسناده راوٍ فأكثر: What has one or more narrators removed from the beginning of its chain
ما سقط من وسط إسناده راوٍ: What has a narrator missing from the middle of its chain
ما اختلف فيه الرواة في المتن: What narrators differ about in the text
ما تفرد به راوٍ من غير متابع: What a narrator alone narrated without corroboration
وكثير من التعليقات في صحيح البخاري، وما: There are many ta‘liqat in Sahih al-Bukhari, and those stated decisively are usually authentic according to Ibn Hajar.
الكذب المختلق المنسوب إلى النبي صلى الله: A fabricated lie attributed to the Prophet ﷺ
الحديث الضعيف الذي رواه راوٍ سيئ الحفظ: A weak hadith narrated by someone with poor memory
حديث انفرد به راوٍ واحد: A hadith narrated by only one narrator
وهو شر الأحاديث الضعيفة، ولا تحل روايته: It is the worst kind of weak hadith, and it is not permissible to narrate it without clarifying that it is fabricated.
أي مما يلي ليس من الدوافع المعروفة للوضع: Which of the following is not a known motive for fabricating hadith according to scholars?
الزندقة والكيد للدين: Heresy and plotting against the religion
الترغيب والترهيب بغير علم من بعض المتعبد: Encouragement and warning without knowledge by some devout people
ذكر العلماء أسبابًا منها الزندقة والعصبي: The scholars mentioned causes including heresy, sectarian bias, storytelling, seeking closeness to rulers, and encouraging asceticism out of ignorance.
إخفاء عيب في الإسناد وتحسين لظاهره: Hiding a defect in the chain and making it look better
رواية الحديث بالمعنى دون اللفظ: Narrating a hadith by meaning rather than by wording
نسبة الحديث إلى غير قائله عمدًا: Deliberately attributing a hadith to someone other than its speaker
ومنه أن يروي عمن عاصره ما لم يسمعه منه ب: An example is narrating from a contemporary something he did not hear from him, using a wording that suggests hearing, such as “‘an” (from).
ما حكم رواية المدلِّس بصيغة محتملة كـ«عن: What is the ruling on the narration of a mudallis using an ambiguous wording such as “‘an” according to the majority of hadith scholars?
لا تُقبل حتى يصرح بالسماع: It is not accepted until he explicitly states hearing
تُقبل مطلقًا إذا كان ثقة: It is always accepted if he is trustworthy
تُرد دائمًا ولو صرح بالسماع: It is always rejected, even if he states hearing
تُقبل إذا كان صحابيًا فقط: It is accepted only if he is a Companion
فإذا قال: «حدثنا» أو «سمعت» اتصل السند و: If he says “he narrated to us” or “I heard”, the chain is connected and the possibility of tadlis is removed.
إذا تعارض جرح مفسَّر وتعديل في راوٍ، فما: If an explained criticism and a declaration of reliability conflict regarding a narrator, what is the well-known rule according to most scholars?
يُقدَّم الجرح المفسَّر على التعديل: An explained criticism takes precedence over a declaration of reliability
يُقدَّم التعديل دائمًا لأن الأصل العدالة: A declaration of reliability always takes precedence because the default is integrity
يُرد الحديث دون نظر: The hadith is rejected without further examination
يُقدَّم قول الأقدم وفاة مطلقًا: The view of the one who died earlier is always preferred
لأن الجارح اطلع على ما خفي على المعدِّل،: Because the critic knew something hidden from the one who declared reliability, provided he states the reason for the criticism.
ما «علم الجرح والتعديل» بإجمال؟: What is the “science of criticism and validation” (jarh wa ta‘dil) in brief?
علم يُعنى ببيان أحوال الرواة من حيث قبول: A science concerned with explaining the condition of narrators in terms of accepting or rejecting their narrations
علم يُعنى بجمع الأحاديث وتبويبها فقط: A science concerned only with gathering and arranging hadiths
علم يبحث في ألفاظ الحديث الغريبة: A science that studies the unfamiliar words of hadith
علم يُعنى بتاريخ جمع الصحف: A science concerned with the history of collecting the scrolls
ومن أئمته يحيى بن معين وأحمد بن حنبل واب: Among its leading scholars are Yahya ibn Ma‘in, Ahmad ibn Hanbal, and Ibn Abi Hatim, author of “Al-Jarh wa at-Ta‘dil”.
الكتب الستة والموطأ والمسند والمكثرون: The six books, the Muwatta’, the Musnad, and the most prolific narrators
ما سنة وفاة الإمام البخاري صاحب «الجامع: In what year did Imam al-Bukhari, author of “Al-Jami‘ as-Sahih”, die?
هو محمد بن إسماعيل البخاري، توفي في خرتن: He is Muhammad ibn Isma‘il al-Bukhari, who died in Khartank near Samarqand on the night of Eid al-Fitr.
ما الاسم الكامل لصحيح البخاري؟: What is the full title of Sahih al-Bukhari?
الجامع المسند الصحيح المختصر من أمور رسو: Al-Jami‘ al-Musnad as-Sahih al-Mukhtasar min Umur Rasulillah ﷺ wa Sunanihi wa Ayyamihi
المسند الصحيح المختصر من السنن بنقل العد: Al-Musnad as-Sahih al-Mukhtasar min as-Sunan bi-Naql al-‘Adl ‘an al-‘Adl
الموطأ الصحيح من أحاديث رسول الله صلى ال: Al-Muwatta’ as-Sahih min Ahadith Rasulillah ﷺ
أما مسلم فاسم كتابه «المسند الصحيح المخت: As for Muslim, the title of his book is “Al-Musnad as-Sahih al-Mukhtasar min as-Sunan bi-Naql al-‘Adl ‘an al-‘Adl ila Rasulillah ﷺ”.
من صاحب الصحيح الذي توفي سنة § هـ بنيساب: Who is the author of the Sahih who died in the year § AH in Nishapur?
وهو تلميذ البخاري وقرينه، ويُعرف الكتابا: He was a student and contemporary of al-Bukhari, and the two books together are known as the “Sahihayn”.
من مؤلف «السنن» المشهور الذي كان سجستاني: Who is the author of the famous “Sunan” who was from Sijistan and died in the year § AH?
وهو سليمان بن الأشعث السجستاني، واشتهرت: He is Sulayman ibn al-Ash‘ath as-Sijistani, and his Sunan is known for its many hadiths of rulings.
أي كتب الستة اشتُهر بتقسيم الحديث إلى صح: Which of the six books is known for dividing hadith into sahih, hasan, and gharib, and for a book of “‘Ilal” at its end?
وتوفي الترمذي سنة § هـ، ويُعد كتابه من أ: At-Tirmidhi died in the year § AH, and his book is among the first to popularize the term “hasan”.
ما اسم الكتاب الذي هو المجتبى من «السنن: What is the name of the book that is the selected version of an-Nasa’i’s “Sunan al-Kubra”?
توفي النسائي سنة § هـ، وكتابه «المجتبى»: An-Nasa’i died in the year § AH, and his “Al-Mujtaba” is, according to one view, the least weak of the six books after the two Sahihs.
أي هذه الكتب ليس من «السنن الأربعة»؟: Which of these books is not among the “Four Sunan”?
السنن الأربعة: أبو داود والترمذي والنسائ: The Four Sunan: Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidhi, an-Nasa’i, and Ibn Majah; the six are these with the two Sahihs.
من مؤلف «الموطأ» وإلى أي مدينة تنسب مدرس: Who is the author of the “Muwatta’”, and to which city is his school attributed?
مالك بن أنس، إمام دار الهجرة: Malik ibn Anas, Imam of Dar al-Hijrah (Madinah)
أحمد بن حنبل، إمام بغداد: Ahmad ibn Hanbal, Imam of Baghdad
توفي الإمام مالك بالمدينة سنة § هـ، والم: Imam Malik died in Madinah in the year § AH, and the Muwatta’ is among the oldest surviving hadith and fiqh works.
كتاب رتب فيه أحمد بن حنبل الأحاديث على أ: A book in which Ahmad ibn Hanbal arranged hadiths by the names of Companions
كتاب رتب فيه أحاديثه على أبواب الفقه: A book in which he arranged hadiths by chapters of fiqh
كتاب اقتصر فيه على الصحيح المتفق عليه: A book limited to the agreed-upon authentic hadiths
كتاب جمع فيه علل الأحاديث: A book gathering the hidden defects of hadiths
توفي الإمام أحمد سنة § هـ، والمسند فيه ا: Imam Ahmad died in the year § AH, and the Musnad contains authentic, hasan, and weak hadiths.
من أكثر الصحابة رواية للحديث عن النبي صل: Which Companion narrated the most hadiths from the Prophet ﷺ?
روى نحو خمسة آلاف حديث وثلاثمئة على المش: He narrated about five thousand three hundred hadiths according to the well-known view, followed by Abdullah ibn ‘Umar, Anas, ‘A’ishah, Ibn ‘Abbas, Jabir, and Abu Sa‘id al-Khudri.
نزول القرآن وأسبابه والمكي والمدني: The revelation of the Qur’an, its occasions, and the Makkan and Madinan surahs
ما معنى نزول القرآن «منجَّمًا»؟: What does it mean that the Qur’an was revealed “munajjaman” (in portions)?
نزوله مفرَّقًا على مدى نحو ثلاث وعشرين س: It was revealed in parts over about twenty-three years
نزوله جملة واحدة في ليلة القدر على النبي: It was revealed all at once on the Night of Power to the Prophet ﷺ
نزوله في الليل دون النهار: It was revealed at night and not by day
نزوله على ترتيب المصحف الحالي: It was revealed in the order of the current Mushaf
وروي عن ابن عباس أنه نزل جملة إلى بيت ال: It is narrated from Ibn ‘Abbas that it came down all at once to Bayt al-‘Izzah in the lowest heaven, then was revealed in portions.
ما أول ما نزل من القرآن على النبي صلى ال: What was the first thing revealed of the Qur’an to the Prophet ﷺ?
ثبت في حديث عائشة رضي الله عنها في بدء ا: This is established in the hadith of ‘A’ishah (may Allah be pleased with her) about the beginning of revelation (Sahih al-Bukhari). As for Al-Muddaththir, it was the first revealed after the pause in revelation, in the hadith of Jabir.
أي الآيات تدل على نزول القرآن في ليلة ال: Which verses indicate that the Qur’an was revealed on the Night of Power?
﴿إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَد: ﴿“Indeed, We sent it down during the Night of Power.”﴾
﴿وَقُرْآنًا فَرَقْنَاهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُ عَل: ﴿“And [it is] a Qur’an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period.”﴾
﴿وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْ: ﴿“And We have certainly made the Qur’an easy for remembrance.”﴾
﴿إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِ: ﴿“Indeed, it is We who sent down the Reminder, and indeed, We will be its guardian.”﴾
سورة القدر، وهي موافقة لقوله تعالى في ال: Surah Al-Qadr, which agrees with Allah’s statement in Al-Baqarah that it was revealed in the month of Ramadan.
منها نحو ثلاث عشرة سنة بمكة ونحو عشر بال: Of these, about thirteen years were in Makkah and about ten in Madinah.
ما الحكمة من تنجيم القرآن التي نص عليها: What is the wisdom of revealing the Qur’an in portions, as stated in the verse ﴿“that We may strengthen your heart thereby”﴾?
تثبيت فؤاد النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم والت: Strengthening the heart of the Prophet ﷺ and gradual legislation
إظهار عجز العرب عن حفظه جملة: Showing the Arabs’ inability to memorize it all at once
إتاحة الوقت للصحابة لتأليف السور: Giving the Companions time to compose the surahs
مراعاة اختلاف لهجات القبائل فقط: Taking only the differences between tribal dialects into account
الآية § من سورة الفرقان، ومن حكمه تيسير: Verse § of Surah Al-Furqan. Another wisdom is making it easier to memorize and understand, and keeping pace with events.
ما القاعدة الأصولية المشهورة في أسباب ال: What is the well-known principle of legal theory about the occasions of revelation?
العبرة بعموم اللفظ لا بخصوص السبب: What counts is the generality of the wording, not the specificity of the cause
العبرة بخصوص السبب لا بعموم اللفظ: What counts is the specificity of the cause, not the generality of the wording
لا يُستدل بآية لها سبب نزول: A verse with an occasion of revelation cannot be used as evidence
كل آية لها سبب نزول واحد لا غير: Every verse has exactly one occasion of revelation and no more
وهذا مذهب الجمهور، فتنسحب الأحكام على كل: This is the view of the majority, so the rulings apply to everyone in a situation similar to the cause.
أي هذه الأمور من خصائص السور المكية في ا: Which of these are generally characteristics of the Makkan surahs?
الحديث عن التوحيد والبعث وقصص الأنبياء و: Discussion of Tawhid, resurrection, stories of the prophets, and short verses
تفصيل أحكام المواريث والحدود: Detailed rulings on inheritance and legal punishments
الحديث عن المنافقين وأحكام الجهاد: Discussion of hypocrites and rulings of jihad
تفصيل أحكام الأسرة والمعاملات: Detailed rulings on family and transactions
وتغلب الأحكام التشريعية والحديث عن المنا: Legislative rulings and discussion of hypocrites and the People of the Book are more typical of the Madinan surahs.
ما ضابط «المدني» عند أكثر العلماء؟: What is the criterion of “Madani” according to most scholars?
ما نزل بعد الهجرة ولو نزل بمكة: What was revealed after the Hijrah, even if revealed in Makkah
ما نزل في المدينة المنورة فقط: What was revealed in Madinah only
ما خاطب أهل الكتاب: What addressed the People of the Book
ما نزل بعد غزوة بدر فقط: What was revealed only after the Battle of Badr
كالآيات التي نزلت يوم الفتح أو في حجة ال: Such as the verses revealed on the day of the Conquest or during the Farewell Pilgrimage; they are Madinan in terms of time.
البقرة أول سورة نزلت بالمدينة بعد الهجرة: Al-Baqarah is the first surah revealed in Madinah after the Hijrah according to the well-known view, while Al-An‘am, Ya-Sin, and Al-Kahf are Makkan.
في أي مما يلي وافق القرآن رأي عمر بن الخ: In which of the following did the Qur’an agree with the opinion of ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab (may Allah be pleased with him), as in Sahih al-Bukhari?
اتخاذ مقام إبراهيم مصلى: Taking the Station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer
قال عمر: وافقت ربي في ثلاث: في مقام إبرا: ‘Umar said: “I agreed with my Lord in three matters: the Station of Ibrahim, the hijab, and the prisoners of Badr.”
جمع القرآن والقراءات والأحرف السبعة: The collection of the Qur’an, the recitations, and the seven ahruf
من الصحابي الذي أشار على أبي بكر بجمع ال: Which Companion advised Abu Bakr to collect the Qur’an after the Battle of Yamamah?
خشي عمر ذهاب القرآن بموت القراء، فأقنع أ: ‘Umar feared the Qur’an would be lost with the death of the reciters, so he convinced Abu Bakr (Sahih al-Bukhari).
من كلَّفه أبو بكر بجمع القرآن في الصحف؟: Whom did Abu Bakr assign to collect the Qur’an into the scrolls?
وكان شابًا عاقلًا لا يُتهم، وكان يكتب ال: He was an intelligent young man, beyond suspicion, who used to write the revelation for the Prophet ﷺ.
عند من حُفظت الصحف بعد وفاة عمر رضي الله: With whom were the scrolls kept after the death of ‘Umar (may Allah be pleased with him)?
كانت عند أبي بكر ثم عمر ثم عند حفصة أم ا: They were with Abu Bakr, then ‘Umar, then with Hafsah, Mother of the Believers (Sahih al-Bukhari).
من الصحابي الذي أفزعه اختلاف الناس في ال: Which Companion was alarmed by people’s differences in recitation and advised ‘Uthman to unite them on a single Mushaf?
رأى الاختلاف في غزوة أرمينية وأذربيجان (: He saw the differences during the campaign of Armenia and Azerbaijan (Sahih al-Bukhari).
بأي لسان أمر عثمان اللجنة بالكتابة إذا ا: In which dialect did ‘Uthman instruct the committee to write when they differed with Zayd ibn Thabit?
بلسان الأنصار: In the dialect of the Ansar
قال عثمان للرهط القرشيين: فإنما نزل بلسا: ‘Uthman said to the Qurayshi group: “It was revealed in their tongue.” (Sahih al-Bukhari).
ماذا فعل عثمان رضي الله عنه بما سوى المص: What did ‘Uthman (may Allah be pleased with him) do with the other scrolls and copies besides the ‘Uthmanic Mushafs?
أمر بدفنها في المدينة: He ordered them buried in Madinah
أبقاها عند القراء: He left them with the reciters
أمر بتوزيعها على الأمصار: He ordered them distributed to the regions
ورد الصحف إلى حفصة (صحيح البخاري)، وكان: He returned the scrolls to Hafsah (Sahih al-Bukhari), and this was done with the Companions’ approval.
قراءة ورش مروية عن أي إمام من القراء الس: The recitation of Warsh is narrated from which of the seven reciters?
وهي الرواية الشائعة في المغرب العربي وغر: It is the common narration in the Maghreb and West Africa.
من الراوي عن نافع المدني من بين هؤلاء؟: Which of these is a narrator from Nafi‘ al-Madani?
والراويان المشهوران عن نافع: قالون وورش،: The two famous narrators from Nafi‘ are Qalun and Warsh; Hafs is the narrator of ‘Asim.
قراءة حفص عن عاصم هي الأكثر انتشارًا الي: The recitation of Hafs from ‘Asim is the most widespread today. From which Imam did Hafs narrate?
وعاصم من التابعين، وانتشرت روايته في الد: ‘Asim was among the Followers, and his narration spread in the Ottoman state and then in printed Mushafs.
ما صحة القول بأن «الأحرف السبعة» هي القر: How correct is the claim that the “seven ahruf” are the seven famous recitations?
غير صحيح؛ فالقراءات السبع اختارها ابن مج: Incorrect; the seven recitations were chosen by Ibn Mujahid and are not the ahruf
صحيح؛ فكل قراءة منها حرف: Correct; each recitation is a harf

تقييد مطلق بدليل منفصل: Restricting an unrestricted ruling by a separate evidence
ويشترط تعارض الدليلين وتعذر الجمع بينهما: It requires that the two evidences conflict, that combining them be impossible, and that the earlier and later be known.

أشهر مثال على النسخ في الشريعة هو:: The most famous example of abrogation in the Sharia is:

ما أفضل طرق التفسير عند العلماء مرتبةً؟: What are the best methods of tafsir according to scholars, in order?
القرآن بالقرآن ثم السنة ثم أقوال الصحابة: The Qur’an by the Qur’an, then the Sunnah, then the Companions’ sayings, then the Followers, then language and ijtihad
اللغة ثم أقوال الصحابة ثم السنة ثم القرآ: Language, then the Companions’ sayings, then the Sunnah, then the Qur’an
الرأي المجرد ثم السنة ثم القرآن: Pure opinion, then the Sunnah, then the Qur’an
السنة ثم أقوال المتأخرين ثم القرآن: The Sunnah, then the words of later scholars, then the Qur’an
نص عليه ابن تيمية في مقدمة أصول التفسير،: Ibn Taymiyyah stated it in the introduction to “Usul at-Tafsir”, and Ibn Kathir followed it in the introduction to his tafsir.
ما شرط قبول التفسير بالرأي (الاجتهاد) عن: What is the condition for accepting tafsir by opinion (ijtihad) according to scholars?
أن يكون مستندًا إلى علم باللغة والشريعة: That it be based on knowledge of language, the Sharia, and the principles of tafsir
أن يوافق هوى المفسر وفهمه الخاص: That it agree with the interpreter’s desire and private understanding
أن يخالف ما ورد عن السلف: That it contradict what came from the early generations
أن يقتصر على ظاهر اللفظ دون سياق: That it be limited to the apparent wording without context
أما التفسير بمجرد الرأي والهوى فمذموم، و: As for tafsir by mere opinion and desire, it is condemned, including the commentaries of sects that read verses in light of their own doctrines.
